content: Per MDN: requestAnimationFrame is automatically paused/throttled in background tabs in most browsers since 2015, but this is not guaranteed across all engines — best practice is to explicitly listen to visibilitychange, cancelAnimationFrame(id) on document.visibilityState==='hidden', and restart the loop on 'visible'. For prefers-reduced-motion, freeze the shader at a single static frame (render once with fixed u_time or u_time=0) and/or swap to the poster image. Always pair cancelAnimationFrame with restart to avoid duplicate loops.
